title: Your lounge pass “expires at boarding”
scenario: A push notification says your lounge membership has a billing problem and will be suspended when boarding starts. You are standing outside the lounge and the notification offers a one-tap card update.

answers.A: Use the notification while you are physically at the lounge, because the timing makes the alert likely genuine.
answers.B: Open the lounge or card issuer app yourself and check membership status there.
answers.C: Ask the lounge desk whether your membership scans as active before changing any payment details.

explanation: Physical context makes digital impersonation feel trustworthy, but the alert still controls the payment path.
proTip: Being in the right place does not make an incoming link the right channel.
